newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thinly mixed levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thinly mixed levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at thinly mixed levels Tuesday on St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none Monday.
- 10 barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week June, bid 105 percent of tariff, down 2-1/2 percent from Monday, offer 115 percent.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of July, bid 100 percent, up five percentage points from May 12, similar, no offer.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of September, bid 150 percent, similar from Monday, no comparison, no offer.
- Eight barges, Ohio River, two each week of September, bid 150 percent, no comparison, no offer.
